item.title: Cyclist dies following A1 collision at Foston
item.description: Lincolnshire police have confirmed that a man in his 40s has died after a collision on the A1 at Foston. Officers were called to the incident involving a cyclist on the northbound carriageway at around 12.50am today (Friday, 23 January). The man died at the scene from his injuries.
